bullets.text: Minister Dr. R. Kumar inspected the floodwater removal operations in Velachery.
Rotary International District 3233 honored 113 teachers at Guru Nanak College in Velachery.
Velachery residents urged authorities to provide a permanent, scientifically validated flood mitigation plan.
Heavy rainfall caused severe waterlogging in Velachery, prompting the deployment of emergency boats.
Blocked drains with two feet of waste caused severe flooding near the Velachery Vijayanagar junction.
Heavy rain caused severe waterlogging on Taramani Main Road, causing major difficulties for motorists.
The Greater Chennai Corporation reopened three flooded subways and restored major bus routes after heavy rain.
Heavy rains caused waterlogging in residential areas across Ponneri and Minjur.
Gummidipoondi MLA S. Vijayakumar inspected flood relief works and stormwater drain operations in the area.
Commuters faced difficulties as construction delays at the Avadi bus terminus affected transport services.
Vultr and AMD announced plans to build India's largest AI supercluster with a 20 MW data center in Chennai.
Google announced a 15 billion dollar investment in an AI hub in Visakhapatnam to support local AI services.
The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting warned private satellite TV channels against the misuse of AI in news.
Police arrested 200 farmers who staged a road blockade protest demanding cooperative crop loan waivers in Thiruvallur.
